Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for activities in assay CHEMBL4513220. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then join compound_structures on molregno to require structures. Filter activities by assay_id matching CHEMBL4513220, standard_value not null, and standard_relation equals '='. Keep every qualifying activity row without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
